observations.why: Directive issued with forward-looking commitment energy — establishing a cadence with decisive, energized authority.
Aphoristic warning framing unrehearsed rollback as a void — urgency-as-worry delivered through stark antithesis.
Settled declarative cadence label — low-arousal satisfaction in institutionalizing a practice.
Calm self-assignment of ownership — settled, low-arousal acceptance of responsibility.

mints.name: StarkWarningAphorism
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the urgency here entering as a stark, aphoristic warning that reframes absence of preparation as absence of the capability itself?
